item.title: AHL: Renwick’s goal lifts Penguins to win over Lehigh Valley
item.description: Nolan Renwick scored his second goal of the season at 9:38 of the second period, which proved the game-winner as the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins rolled to a 6-2 victory over rival Lehigh Valley on Sunday afternoon in Allentown. It marked the fifth win of the season over the Phantoms, improved the Penguins to 29-12-2-2 and moved them within three points of red hot Providence in the Atlantic Division. item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Wilkes-Barre Area tops Pittston Area, extends win streak
item.description: David Jannuzzi scored 19 points and Mike Keating chipped in 12 to lead Wilkes-Barre Area to a 57-44 win over Pittston Area on Sunday night at The Den. Jannuzzi scored 11 of his 19 points in the first half, while Keating scored 10 of his 12 in helping the Wolfpack take a 31-20 lead at the half. Pittston Area held a 16-14 lead at the end of the first quarter. Lucas LoPresto led the Patriots with 12 points. Stephen Barnic and John Jadus each scored eight.

item.title: Social media is distorting our democracy | EDITORIAL
item.description: Editorial: The Trump administration's initial reaction to the shooting of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis shows how the incentives created by social media are distorting truth and undermining deliberation.

item.title: COUNTERPOINT: Higher education may be beyond saving, unless…
item.description: I’ve spent more than two-thirds of a century (since 1958) at American universities. Never in all those years has their earned and deserved reputation as the best in the world suffered bigger threats than today.

item.title: POINT: US higher education can be saved, if…
item.description: American higher education can and must be reformed. If we are genuinely serious about restoring higher education to its proper function, it will look little like it does today.
